purpose: Rapid purely translational planar shaking counterparts to the qualified 3D sphere scene. Separately declared scenes; they do not qualify the failed rotating or mixed-polygon scenes.
geometry: Unit-mass disks, radius .1m, spacing .205m, square container half extent side*.205/2+.045m; gravity9.81m/s2; friction .4; zero restitution; +/-20m/s reversals at .04/.08s; horizon .12s. Container omega0 and analytic poses. Initial velocities0. Actual friction impulse telemetry must be strictly positive.
rule: All original planar full-state quarter/full budgets and physical gates remain unchanged. Both adjacent reference edges must pass before selecting a candidate or timing it. One warmup per variant and three alternating interleaved repetitions; each timed result must pass and repeat states bitwise. Preserve all failures. No material change across levels. Source/plan must be published before execution. No speed ranking for an unqualified reference.
limitations: Synthetic translational shaking of disks only; not rotating containers, arbitrary polygons or calibrated materials. Experimental transformed Float64 Box2D backend. Costs include native collision discovery, stepping, observers and state recording; process costs retained. External host load uncontrolled.
